scripts.title: Run to success
scripts.features: You has infinite stamina... you can change your own speed but i'd recommend 20 (chatgpt made)
scripts.script:
--------------------------------------------------
-- SERVICES
--------------------------------------------------
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer

--------------------------------------------------
-- CONFIG
--------------------------------------------------
local NORMAL_SPEED = 12
local RUN_SPEED = 22
local RUN_ANIMATION_ID = "rbxassetid://87945256029788"

--------------------------------------------------
-- VARIABLES
--------------------------------------------------
local humanoid
local runTrack
local shiftHeld = false

--------------------------------------------------
-- SETUP CHARACTER
--------------------------------------------------
local function setupCharacter(character)
    humanoid = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
    humanoid.WalkSpeed = NORMAL_SPEED

    local animation = Instance.new("Animation")
    animation.AnimationId = RUN_ANIMATION_ID

    runTrack = humanoid:LoadAnimation(animation)
    runTrack.Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Movement
end

LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(setupCharacter)
if LocalPlayer.Character then
    setupCharacter(LocalPlayer.Character)
end

--------------------------------------------------
-- RENDER LOOP: handles speed + animation
--------------------------------------------------
RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
    if not humanoid then return end

    -- SPEED CONTROL
    if shiftHeld then
        humanoid.WalkSpeed = RUN_SPEED
    else
        humanoid.WalkSpeed = NORMAL_SPEED
    end

    -- ANIMATION CONTROL
    if shiftHeld and humanoid.MoveDirection.Magnitude > 0 then
        if runTrack and not runTrack.IsPlaying then
            runTrack:Play()
        end
    else
        if runTrack and runTrack.IsPlaying then
            runTrack:Stop()
        end
    end
end)

--------------------------------------------------
-- INPUT HANDLING
--------------------------------------------------
UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gpe)
    if gpe then return end
    if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift then
        shiftHeld = true
    end
end)

UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
    if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift then
        shiftHeld = false
    end
end)

print("[Sprint] Movement-based sprint with proper release active.")

esp

team colors

· security/mtf = blue
· chaos = green
· serpents hand = pink
· foundation = light blue
· goc = cyan

teleports

· 9 map locations (escape, nuke, gate a, etc)
· tp to any player
· tp where ur mouse is looking
· set ur own keybind (default is T)

other

scripts.title: SCP RETRO BREACH V2
scripts.features:
A simple and user-friendly GUI that provides essential movement, visual, and utility enhancements in one place.
It includes features such as speed, flight, noclip, infinite jump, custom wallhack, player and item ESP, camera control, and other quality-of-life options.
The interface is designed in a clean, settings-style layout that is easy to understand and quick to use.

Notes:

The desync feature is not finished yet and will most likely cause you to get kicked from the game.

Flying too fast upward may result in an automatic kick; this cannot be bypassed by the Anti-Kick feature.

Some functions may not work in all games.

The script is actively updated.
